recreation_brief:
1. Set slide background to light beige (#F5E8D0).
2. Add title text 'Neural Network Model' at top center in bold, large, dark red (#8B0000), sans-serif.
3. Add subtitle text '(How Weights of hidden layer affect Calculated Error)' directly below the title in bold, blue (#0000FF), sans-serif, slightly smaller than the title.
4. Add a circle at the top right containing the number '16'.
5. Add a purple rounded rectangle at top left with fill #DDA0DD and border/text #800080, labeled 'Input Sample', with a left-pointing arrow from the box into the neural network.
6. Add a purple rounded rectangle at top right with fill #DDA0DD and border/text #800080, labeled 'Target Label', with a right-pointing arrow from the network to the box.
7. Draw the neural network diagram in the center:
   a. Place small input dots on the far left.
   b. Place 3 white input circles to the right of the dots, each containing 'Σ'.
   c. Place green (#00FF00) hidden-layer circles in the middle, each containing 'Σ' and labeled 'O_j'.
   d. Place orange (#FFA500) output-layer circles on the right, each containing 'Σ' and labeled 'O_k'.
   e. Draw arrows from the input circles to the hidden circles labeled 'w_ji'.
   f. Draw arrows from the hidden circles to the output circles labeled 'w_kj'.
   g. Add small boxes labeled 'f' immediately after each summation node.
   h. Add purple (#800080) bias circles containing '1' connected to the nodes, with 'Node Bias' text nearby.
   i. Add curved dashed arrows from the output side back toward earlier layers to show error backpropagation paths.
   j. Add 3 output boxes to the right of the output nodes labeled 'Output 1', 'Output 2', and 'Output m'.
8. Add a vertical red (#8B0000) rectangle at the right edge with white (#FFFFFF) vertical text 'Error Error'.
9. Add boxes labeled 'Class 1', 'Class 2', and 'Class m' at the end of the red error bar.
10. Add a blue box at bottom left-center with fill #E6F3FF and border/text #0000FF, labeled 'Previous Layer (l)', with an upward arrow labeled 'i'.
11. Add a green box at bottom center with fill #E6FFE6 and border/text #008000, labeled 'Current Layer (You are here)', with an upward arrow labeled 'j'.
12. Add an orange box at bottom right-center with fill #FFE6CC and border/text #FF8C00, labeled 'Next Layer (K)', with an upward arrow labeled 'k'.
13. Add a white box with red (#FF0000) border at bottom right labeled 'Note: Layer "j" is NOT Output Layer'.
14. Add a white equation box at bottom left with header 'For Layer "j"' followed by the equations 'Net_j = Σ (w_ji * O_i)' and 'O_j = f(Net_j) = 1 / (1 + e^-Net_j)' in black text.
15. Add a white equation box at bottom right containing 'E = 1/2 Σ_j (t_j - O_j)^2' followed by three red X marks.
